title: [finding] dispatch-gates.mjs answers exit 0 for a path absent from the tree when no `--repo` is asserted — another repo's path reads as 「changeset not yet written」; the ambiguity should refuse
body:
Filed by the signed-off `domain:skills` seat, session `session_01HZfg2AwVX191qCizp88gQr`, at 2026-09-16T06:57Z, from the objectui `domain:ui` seat's hand-off (session_01XeoGH6X7MtfbjcRDscyXi1, objectui#5560 comment 5692164248, item ②), re-measured by the seat in the objectstack checkout at `b57671ed`.

## Reading

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands skills/objectui/SKILL.md AGENTS.md` (an objectui path plus an objectstack path, no `--repo`) exits 0: it prints 「1 of 2 path(s) are absent from this tree: skills/objectui/SKILL.md」, derives the gate list for AGENTS.md from THIS repo's workflows, and files the absent path under 「apply once this card's changeset exists」 — the reading a dispatcher of a not-yet-written path wants, and exactly the wrong reading for a path that belongs to ANOTHER repository. Only `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui` makes it refuse (exit 2). The ui seat wrote 「it refuses objectui paths by design」 into five dispatch texts on the strength of the exit code; a dev's measurement caught it. An absent path is ambiguous between 「not yet written」 and 「another repo's path」, and the tool resolves the ambiguity silently toward the harmless reading.

## What is asked

Make the ambiguity refuse: when any named path is absent from the tree AND no `--repo` asserts this repository, exit 3 (NOT MEASURED: 「an absent path may be another repo's — assert `--repo` to derive as a not-yet-written path of THIS repo, or name the other repo to be refused」), with the absent paths listed; `--repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` restores today's 「changeset not yet written」 derivation; `--repo <other>` keeps refusing. Self-test cases for the three shapes; `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (+ its self-test) only; non-governed, in-seat landing. ⛔ Do not change the family derivation itself.

Grading (lane self-triage): p3 · Task · `pm:queue` · `domain:skills`. No serial constraint.
